Best regards,

additional_info.subject: ID0476336-DC/Si-D/FI- [MP / P9 170001029] Dispenser Offline CRM:03431000016
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus,
I just talked with Simen and he said he found same problem in Norway and he told me this:
Troubleshooting from field: TB210 seems to be broken with full load connected. With full load FC212,213 and 214 all units blinking on LED and measured on DC out on TB210 and voltage jumping from 0-24V all the time. We removed the load and with only F212 connected, turned on TB210 again and we get stable voltage. If we connect more than FC212 TB210 start to jump with voltage again, indicating a problem with connected load. We see some glue? and miscolor on TB210 indicating heat inside TB210
Do you have this kind of behaviour?
BR,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0476336-DC/Si-D/FI- [MP / P9 170001029] Dispenser Offline CRM:03431000016
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus, good morning.
As we discussed, with all the evidence provided, the problem seems to be related to the Power supply TB210.
I recommend replacing it as it's acting weirdly. I know that the chargers are out of warranty but there is nothing we can do, unless you find a fix by changing the hardware of the charger in order to make the power supply not having such a surge of current.
I will send this ticket to RC-FI queue.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
